**Subject: Order TH-48217 marked as delivered but never received – resolution required by 13 November**

Dear Tiny Hands Edu Supplies Customer Service

I am writing about order **TH-48217**, placed on **21 October** and paid for by card. The total was **R1,640, including the R95 delivery fee**.

The order was for supplies for my class at **Bergview Pre-Primary in Plumstead**:

- 6 tubs of finger paint  
- 4 bags of playdough  
- 200 paper plates  
- Googly eyes  
- Glitter glue  
- 2 rolls of brown paper  

The delivery address on the order was correct. However, while the tracking states that the parcel was delivered on **Tuesday, 3 November at 11:42**, and signed for by **“M. Adams”**, it never arrived at the school. Nobody at Bergview Pre-Primary is named Adams. Our gate guard, Uncle Faizel, also keeps a written record of every delivery, and there is no entry for this parcel on 3 November.

I emailed you on **4 November and again on 6 November**. Both times, I received the same copy-and-paste response: *“we have escalated your query to our courier partner.”* I then phoned on Friday and spent **38 minutes on hold**, only to be told that nothing could be done until the courier had completed its investigation, which could take another **10 working days**.

I am extremely frustrated by this. My purchase is with **Tiny Hands Edu Supplies**, not with the courier. I did not choose the courier, and I should not be left out of pocket while you and your courier decide what happened. A tracking record showing an unfamiliar signature does not change the fact that the school has not received my order.

This is also not simply a minor inconvenience for me. I paid the **R1,640 myself**, on a teacher’s salary, to buy materials for other people’s children. The children completed their mask patterns last week, and I have been telling them for a week that the paint is “coming soon”. We also need these supplies to make props for our **end-of-year concert on 27 November**, so I cannot keep waiting indefinitely.

I have ordered from Tiny Hands three times before without any problems, which is part of why this experience has been so disappointing. I expected much better from a company I had been happy to support.

Please resolve this by **Friday, 13 November**, in one of the following ways:

1. **Resend the complete order at no additional cost**, with proper confirmation of dispatch and tracking, and ensure it arrives in good time for me to prepare for the concert on 27 November; **or**
2. **Refund the full R1,640**, including the R95 delivery fee.

Please reply with a clear answer confirming which option you are actioning. I need someone to read what has actually happened and respond properly, rather than sending another template telling me that my query has been escalated.

I would much prefer to resolve this directly with you. However, if I receive no substantive response by 13 November, I will pursue a chargeback through my bank and leave an honest review describing my experience.

I look forward to a prompt and proper resolution.

Kind regards  
[Your name]  
Bergview Pre-Primary, Plumstead  
Order TH-48217
